column1: # page_family is a per-page label from an upstream classifier
# (source: corpus/evals/page_family.jsonl, joined into pages.jsonl by the exporter).
# It is not per-cohort ground truth. Legacy hub pages (like dse/StartSeite,
# labelled vermont-rent) host many unrelated cohorts on one page; the classifier
# picks one label per page from whichever signal is strongest in the visible post-cut window.
